## Introduction
```{r}
library(fdaPDE)
library(femR)

mesh_data_path <- "../data/mesh/unit_square"
obs_data_path <- "../data/models/fpca/2D_test"
results_path <- "results"

file.remove(list.files(path = mesh_data_path, full.names = TRUE))
file.remove(list.files(path = obs_data_path, full.names = TRUE))
file.remove(list.files(path = results_path, full.names = TRUE))
```


## Parameters
- `params.json` modifies the run parameters
```{r}
library(jsonlite)

json_data <- fromJSON("params.json")

json_data$RunParams$n_cores <- unbox(params$n_cores)
json_data$RunParams$n_pc <- unbox(3)

json_data$calibration$grid_dim <- unbox(30)
json_data$calibration$strategy <- unbox("gcv")
json_data$calibration$left <- unbox(-16)
json_data$calibration$right <- unbox(-1)
json_data$calibration$n_folds <- unbox(params$n_folds)
json_data$calibration$gcv_correction <- unbox(1.0)

write_json(json_data, 
           "params.json", 
           pretty = TRUE)
```

- set the parameters to generate the data
```{r}
n_units <- params$n_statistical_units
n_nodes <- params$n_nodes
n_locs <- params$n_locs
n_replicas <- params$n_replicas

seed = 467897965 ## for reproducibility purposes
```

## Data
Utils
```{r}
source("../r-utils/mesh_utils.R")
```


```{r}
##(1) Mesh generation
mesh.2D <- unit_square.mesh(n_nodes, mesh_data_path)
L2norm <- L2norm.factory(mesh.2D) #function to compute the norm

##(2) Eigenfunctions
## use n = N for the setting locations = mesh nodes
## (in this case, \Psi is the identity matrix)
## use n != N for the general case. Set n > N.

locations.obs.2D <- unit_square.locs(n_locs,obs_data_path)

## (2.1) at mesh nodes
## evaluate eigenfunctions on mesh nodes (this is equivalent to get the FEM basis
## expansion of the eigenfunctions ). change values of a and b to select eigenfunction
f1_fem <- square_eigenfunction(a = 1, b = 1, mesh.2D$nodes)
f2_fem <- square_eigenfunction(a = 2, b = 3, mesh.2D$nodes)
f3_fem <- square_eigenfunction(a = 4, b = 4, mesh.2D$nodes)

## (2.2) at locations (normalized)
Psi <- Psi.matrix(mesh.2D, locations.obs.2D)

f1 <- as.matrix(Psi %*% f1_fem/L2norm(f1_fem))
f2 <- as.matrix(Psi %*% f2_fem/L2norm(f2_fem))
f3 <- as.matrix(Psi %*% f3_fem/L2norm(f3_fem))

true_PCs <- cbind(f1,f2,f3)

##(3) Data generation
#-> generated for each replica
```

## Metrics
```{r}
source("../r-utils/error_metrics.R")

keys <- c("calibration","gcv_correction","replica")

error_metrics <- c("signal_reconstruction_error",
                   "space_reconstruction_error")

time_metrics <- c("calibration_time","factorization_time","fit_time")

#storing the results
test_results <- 
   data.frame(matrix(nrow=0,ncol=length(c(keys,error_metrics,time_metrics,"lambda"))))
names(test_results) <- c(keys,error_metrics,time_metrics,"lambda")

test_results[] <- lapply(test_results, function(x) numeric())
test_results$calibration <- character()
```

Utility to compute the errors

## Run
```{r}
library(dplyr)

for(ind_rep in 1:n_replicas){
  #data 
  data <- data_generator(n_units,
                       true_PCs = true_PCs,
                       scores_sd = c(0.4,0.3,0.2),
                       error_sd = 0.1,
                       obs_path = obs_data_path,
                       seed = seed + 4*ind_rep)
  
  for (cal_policy in c("gcv","full_smooth_gcv")){
    cat("\nCalibration policy: ", cal_policy, "\n")
    json_data$calibration$strategy <- unbox(cal_policy)
    
    for(curr_gcv_correction in seq(1.0,2.0,by=0.2)){
      cat("GCV correction: ", curr_gcv_correction, "\n")
      json_data$calibration$gcv_correction <- unbox(curr_gcv_correction)
      write_json(json_data, "params.json", pretty = TRUE)
    
      #run the program
      system("/Users/marcogalliani/Desktop/fdaPDE-cpp/cmake-build-default/experiments/mono-calibration/mono_calibration --gtest_filter=* --gtest_color=no")
      
      #load results
      est.PCs <- 
        as.matrix(readMM(file=paste(results_path,"estimated_PCs.mtx",sep="/")))
      est.Scores <- 
        as.matrix(readMM(file=paste(results_path,"estimated_Scores.mtx",sep="/")))
      
      #compute errors
      errors <- compute.errors.FPCA(true_PCs, est.PCs,
                                    data$scores, est.Scores)
      
      #times
      test_report <- read.csv(file=paste(results_path,"test_report.csv",sep="/"),
                              header = F)
      #store results
      test_results <- test_results %>%
          add_row(calibration=cal_policy, gcv_correction=curr_gcv_correction, replica=ind_rep)
      
      new_row <- 
        test_results$calibration==cal_policy & 
        test_results$gcv_correction==curr_gcv_correction & 
        test_results$replica==ind_rep
      test_results[new_row, error_metrics] <- unlist(errors[c("signal_reconstruction","space_reconstruction")])
      test_results[new_row, time_metrics] <- unlist(test_report[,1:3])
      test_results[new_row, "lambda"] <- unlist(test_report[,4])
    }#n_pc
  }#calibration
}#replica

test_results$gcv_correction <- as.factor(test_results$gcv_correction)
```

## Visualization
```{r}
source("../r-utils/plot_utils.R")

library(scales)
library(cowplot)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra) 

col_palette <- hue_pal()(5)
color_map <- c(
  "gcv" = col_palette[1],
  "kcv" = col_palette[2],
  "ocv" = col_palette[3],
  "kcv_cols" = col_palette[4],
  "full_smooth_gcv" = col_palette[5]
)
```
### Errors
```{r}
save <- F

for(err in error_metrics){
  plot <- 
    grouped_boxplot(test_results, "Calibration comparison",
                var_name.x = "gcv_correction", var_name.y = err,
                group_name = "calibration", color_map = color_map,
                legend = T, lines = T)
  print(plot)
  
  if(save){
    ggsave(paste("plots/",
               err,
               "-Mesh",params$n_nodes,
               "-Obs",params$n_obs,
               "-Locs",params$n_locs,
             ".pdf", sep=""), 
         plot, width = 10, height = 5)
  }
}
```
